answer_1.quote: Voice assistant models should give coherent, helpful, and harmless responses to user speech.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy is assessed using the PEDANTS metric, which is tuned for strong correlation with human judgments of reference-based correctness.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 53 participants on the Prolific platform to provide preference ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Users were shown responses from each model, without knowledge of which model was which. To avoid any positional bias, we shuffle the order which users were shown model responses for each recording submitted.
